cards.word: 你好 [nǐ hǎo] | 您好 [nín hǎo]
欢迎 [huānyíng] | 欢迎光临 [huānyíng guānglín]
cards.note: 欢迎光临 is what shops and restaurants say to customers.

cards.word: 祝你今天愉快 [zhù nǐ jīntiān yúkuài]
待会儿见 [dāihuìr jiàn] | 一会儿见 [yíhuìr jiàn]
您好吗? [nín hǎo ma] | 您最近好吗? [nín zuìjìn hǎo ma]
最近怎么样? [zuìjìn zěnmeyàng] | 你好吗? [nǐ hǎo ma]
cards.note: 你好吗? is the textbook phrase; friends more often ask 最近怎么样?

cards.word: 怎么样? [zěnmeyàng] | 干嘛呢? [gàn má ne]
很高兴认识你 [hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ] | 幸会 [xìnghuì]

cards.note: There is no all-purpose yes: people repeat the verb of the question. 你去吗? 去。 = Are you going? Yes.
As with yes, people usually answer with the negated verb: 不去 = no, not going.

cards.word: 非常感谢 [fēicháng gǎnxiè] | 太谢谢了 [tài xièxie le]
不客气 [bú kèqi] | 不用谢 [búyòng xiè]
没什么 [méi shénme] | 哪里哪里 [nǎli nǎli]
请问 [qǐngwèn] | 打扰一下 [dǎrǎo yíxià]
我听不懂 [wǒ tīng bu dǒng] | 我不懂 [wǒ bù dǒng]
cards.note: 听不懂 = I can't understand what I hear; 看不懂 for what you read.

cards.word: 做得好 [zuò de hǎo] | 真棒 [zhēn bàng]
对不起 [duìbuqǐ] | 不好意思 [bù hǎoyìsi]
cards.note: 不好意思 is the lighter one, for small slips or asking a favour.
